description: This file implements a synchronous host resolver for the QUIC protocol, utilizing a dedicated thread to perform DNS resolution asynchronously.

classes.name: ResolverThread
classes.description: A thread class that performs DNS resolution using net::HostResolver in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: ResolverThread::Resolve
methods.description: Starts the resolution process on the resolver thread and waits for completion.

methods.name: ResolverThread::Run
methods.description: Executes the DNS resolution logic within the thread, managing the message loop and resolver request.

methods.name: ResolverThread::OnResolutionComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon resolution completion to store the result and signal completion.

methods.name: SynchronousHostResolver::Resolve
methods.description: Static method that creates a ResolverThread instance to perform synchronous DNS resolution.
